description: This file provides utility functions for mocking and intercepting browser Notification API calls within Playwright tests, including stubbing notifications and waiting for notifications to be received.

classes.name: CustomNotification
classes.description: A subclass of the original Notification class that captures notification details when instantiated.

methods.name: stubNotification
methods.description: Overrides the browser's Notification API to intercept and record notifications during tests.

methods.name: waitForNotification
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a specified number of notifications to be captured within a timeout period.
